tasks.prompt: In SwiftUI with the Observation framework: which property wrapper owns what? Show a view-owned model, passing it to a child that mutates it, and injecting a shared model app-wide.

expect.label: uses the @Observable macro for the model
owns the model with @State in the view that creates it
uses @Bindable where a child needs bindings into it
injects the shared model through the environment

avoid.label: falls back to the legacy ObservableObject trio
